errors.evidence: The description states that the slice for 'Да, веднъж годишно' (26.7%) is beige ('бежев'), but the image shows it as a shade of light purple/lilac.

errors.text_span: с текст вдясно и вътрешен етикет с процент
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that the text labels are to the right ('вдясно') and the percentage labels are internal ('вътрешен етикет'). In the chart, the labels are located all around the pie chart (top-left, bottom-left, right), and all parts of the labels, including percentages, are external to the pie slices.

errors.text_span: Секторите са визуално подредени по размер според процента, който представляват.
errors.evidence: The description claims that the sectors are visually arranged by size, but this is not true. The clockwise order of percentages starting from the top ('Да, непрекъснато') is 8.9%, 8.9%, 13.3%, 22.2%, 26.7%, 20.0%, which is not a sorted order.
